title: Swoosh
blurb: Editing's most-used connective tissue, and the reason so many videos feel like they are moving when nothing is actually happening. A whoosh implies motion all by itself: nothing needs to physically travel anywhere, the sound simply asserts that it did and the viewer accepts it without question. Scene changes, text flying in, a hand gesturing dramatically, a transition between two static images — all of it becomes kinetic. The duct tape of sound design, supplied here in premium quality. Use sparingly, or ignore that advice entirely like everybody else does.
